metadata.explanation: Variation of NBA store filtering task. User must apply 4 filters: women's category, Adidas brand, t-shirts type, and under $30 price. Evaluator checks all filters are present in HTML and URL, with no additional filters applied.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_direct_json_object metric and get_active_tab_html_parse getter. Pattern matches original task structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all 4 required filters (women, Adidas, t-shirts, under $30)
Properly verifies no extra filters are applied via is_other_exist flag
Uses appropriate category 'class&url' to check both HTML elements and URL parameters
Getter logic extracts filter information from elements with class 'filter-selector-link' and validates against URL
Metric check_direct_json_object performs exact boolean comparison of all expected filter keys
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: Getter uses OR logic (filter in HTML OR URL) rather than AND logic (filter in BOTH HTML AND URL). This is slightly permissive but acceptable for display verification.
Depends on specific class name 'filter-selector-link' which may vary across different store implementations, but metadata indicates this follows existing task patterns.
